[SWS_Ea_00078]
Upstream requirements: SRS_MemHwAb_14031
⌈If the current module status is MEMIF_BUSY (i.e. the request to cancel a pending
job is accepted by the function Ea_Cancel), the function Ea_Cancel shall reset the
EA module’s internal variables to make the module ready for a new job request. I.e.
the function Ea_Cancel shall set the job result to MEMIF_JOB_CANCELED and the
module status to MEMIF_IDLE.⌋
